newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria extends deadline for C.Bank intl audit.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria extends deadline for C.Bank intl audit.

text.p: International auditors Deloitte & Touche are expected to complete the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) audit two weeks later than planned because of the large volume of operations involved, the BNB said.
"The BNB's plenary council decided move the deadline for the completion of the audit from October 31 to November 15, 1996 due to the large volume of work to be done," the BNB said in a statement.
Deloitte & Touche was chosen to audit Bulgaria's central bank after winning a tender among five auditors in September.

The BNB's international audit, which was part of the requirements of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) for sealing a $580 million standby agreement in July, was initially expected to be completed by the end of October.
Deloitte & Touche's was considered the most acceptable bidder because of its wide experience in auditing central banks and the competitive price of 28 million levs it offered, the BNB said.
Deloitte & Touche competed with Arthur Andersen, Price Waterhouse, BDO Binder and KPMG. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
